FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 126
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 126 as introduced could increase the obligations of local jails by an undetermined
amount dependent on the number of individuals charged with certain crimes that are denied bail
and any incremental cost of housing any additional inmates.
